command:
uv venv --python 3.10 .diag310 && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$PWD/.diag310 uv sync --locked --all-extras --dev && uv pip install --python .diag310/bin/python 'torch==2.13.0' 'torchaudio==2.11.0' && export UV_NO_SYNC=1 PYTHONFAULTHANDLER=1; mkdir -p algan_outputs; cat > /tmp/pr144_prefix.py <<'PY'
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pytest

TARGETS = ('test_lifted_path_tracer_features_render', 'test_capture_is_off_unless_armed', 'test_a_ray_exactly_on_a_shared_edge_hits_exactly_one_neighbour', 'test_ray_reorder_preserves_other_views_of_the_same_arena')

def pytest_collection_modifyitems(config, items):
    selected = [i for i in items if ('/unit_tests/' in str(i.fspath) and 'test_a' <= Path(str(i.fspath)).name < 'test_n') or any(t in i.nodeid for t in TARGETS)]
    config.hook.pytest_deselected(items=[i for i in items if i not in selected])
    items[:] = selected

_previous = None
@pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=True)
def pytest_runtest_protocol(item, nextitem):
    global _previous
    yield
    from algan.taichi_compat import submodule
    from algan.settings import SETTINGS
    cfg = submodule('lang.impl').current_cfg()
    values = {k: repr(getattr(cfg, k)) for k in dir(cfg) if not k.startswith('_') and not callable(getattr(cfg, k))}
    values['env'] = repr(sorted((k, v) for k, v in os.environ.items() if k.startswith(('ALGAN_', 'QD_', 'TI_'))))
    values['settings'] = repr(SETTINGS.raytracing.to_dict())
    if values != _previous:
        difference = values if _previous is None else {k: (v, _previous.get(k)) for k, v in values.items() if v != _previous.get(k)}
        with open('algan_outputs/state-trace.jsonl', 'a') as out:
            out.write(json.dumps({'after': item.nodeid, 'changes': difference}) + '\n')
        _previous = values
PY
PYTHONPATH=/tmp:$PWD .diag310/bin/python -m pytest -v -p pr144_prefix --cov=algan -n 1 tests/unit_tests tests/fast
